description: The figure presents four separate pie charts comparing the distribution of error (or issue) categories for different language models (GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct), with each chart showing labeled slices and percentages inside the wedges and no separate legend. The GPT4-o chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark red at 83.3% (5) and “Safety” in a lighter brown at 16.7% (1). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart contains 5 slices: “Misinformation” in brown at 38.4% (33), “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at 22.1% (19), “Ethical Advice” in bluish gray at 16.3% (14), “Clarification” in tan at 14.0% (12), and “Safety” in dark red at 9.3% (8). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in brown at 75.0% (3) and “Clarification” in dark red at 25.0% (1). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices split evenly: “Lack of Knowledge” in brown at 50.0% (2) and “Misinformation” in dark red at 50.0% (2); none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a consistent descending pattern.
